column1: Reserve DistrictBostonEconomic activity was flat, as was employment, and prices increased slightly. International travelwas a bright spot, and the summer tourism season on Cape Cod was described as strong. Morebroadly, consumers remained highly price conscious, and certain manufacturers had persistentlyweak sales. Home sales and home prices softened noticeably over the summer.
